We offer this ocean Of gifts of the Gathering, Immaculate nectar Blessed by our concentration, By our secret words, And by our secret signs, To the gathering Of those who are pledged to defend, And those who protect this place; May You be pleased. Om ah hung, Take Your fill, Revel in these thousand Objects of the senses; Eh ma ho, Accomplish well The mighty deeds Of practitioners.

record.acip: DE LA BDUD RTZI RIL BU DGOS KYANG, RNYING LUGS KYI RTZA BRGYAD STONG SBYAR ZHES PA SHA LNGA BDUD RTZI LNGA SOGS DNGOS SU 'DRES PA'I BDUD RTZI CHOS SMAN BSRE MI RUNG ZHING, 'DI DANG DGE LDAN PA'I BDUD RTZI RIL BU LA KHYAD PAR CHE STE, DGE LUGS LA SHA DANG BDUD RTZIR AA RU RA SOGS KYIS DOD THUB SBYAR BA YIN, SNGA MAS DNGOS SU BSRES PAS RANG GI RTOGS PAS MA 'CHUN NA NYES PA RLABS CHEN 'BYUNG BA'I NYEN YOD,
record.wylie: de la bdud rtsi ril bu dgos kyang, rnying lugs kyi rtsa brgyad stong sbyar zhes pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs dngos su 'dres pa'i bdud rtsi chos sman bsre mi rung zhing, 'di dang dge ldan pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu la khyad par che ste, dge lugs la sha dang bdud rtsir aa ru ra sogs kyis dod thub sbyar ba yin, snga mas dngos su bsres pas rang gi rtogs pas ma 'chun na nyes pa rlabs chen 'byung ba'i nyen yod
record.english: For this practice you will need a nectar pill; but it is improper to mix together a dharma elixir like the "Concoction of Eight Thousand Fundamental Substances" used in the Nyingma tradition, where they add in the real things: the five fleshes, five nectars, and so on. There is a very great difference between this and the nectar pill of the Virtuous Ones.  In the tradition of the Way of Virtue, we mix together cherry plum and similar ingredients to substitute for the fleshes and nectars.  With the other custom, because you have blended in the actual substances, there is a very real danger that you will commit a tremendous bad deed if your realizations are not high enough to sustain the practice.

record.acip: SKYABS GSOL BRJOD PAS SKYABS YUL RNAMS KYI SKU LAS BDUD RTZI 'OD ZER DANG BCAS PA'I RGYUN BABS PAS SEMS CAN THAMS CAD KYI SDIG SGRIB LAS NYON THAMS CAD DAG NAS LUS ZAG MED LONGS SKU RNAL 'BYOR MA DANG, SEMS RTOG MED CHOS SKUR GYUR TE SEMS CAN RNAMS RNAL 'BYOR MAR GYUR PA BYA BRGYA 'UR RDOS BDAS PA BZHIN RANG RANG GI DAG ZHING DU 'PHUR BAR BSAM,
record.wylie: skyabs gsol brjod pas skyabs yul rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi 'od zer dang bcas pa'i rgyun babs pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib las nyon thams cad dag nas lus zag med longs sku rnal 'byor ma dang, sems rtog med chos skur gyur te sems can rnams rnal 'byor mar gyur pa bya brgya 'ur rdos bdas pa bzhin rang rang gi dag zhing du 'phur bar bsam
record.english: In response to these words of refuge and supplication, a great stream of nectar with light rays pours down from the holy bodies of the refuge objects.  This cleans away all the wrong deeds, obstacles, karma, and bad thoughts of all the living beings there.  Imagine that their bodies turn into the Angel's immaculate body of enjoyment, and that their minds turn into Her Dharma body, free of all conceptualization.  Now They are all Her, and suddenly They burst up in flight, each one headed for their own paradise, like a flock of birds running from the stone of a slingshot.

record.acip: RNAM PA'I KHYAD PAR BZO BKOD PHUN SUM TSOGS PA, BYED LAS KYI KHYAD PAR 'BUL YUL GYI DBANG PO SO SOR ZAG MED KYI BDE CHEN BSKYED NUS PAR BSAMS LA,
record.wylie: rnam pa'i khyad par bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa, byed las kyi khyad par 'bul yul gyi dbang po so sor zag med kyi bde chen bskyed nus par bsams la
record.english: The characteristic of what the offerings look like is that they are of perfect quality and arrangement.  The characteristic of what they do is that they have the power to produce intense, immaculate bliss in the particular sense organ towards which they are offered.

record.acip: STENG 'OG MGO MJUG LDOG NAS THOD PAR LHUNG BAS JI TZAM LONGS SPYAD KYANG ZAD PA MED PA'I MANG POR SBAR ZHING SPEL BA 'CHI MED TSE, NAD MED SMAN, ZAG MED YE SHES KYI BDUD RTZIR GYUR PAR BSAM MO,
record.wylie: steng 'og mgo mjug ldog nas thod par lhung bas ji tsam longs spyad kyang zad pa med pa'i mang por sbar zhing spel ba 'chi med tshe, nad med sman, zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam mo
record.english: The letters now fall down into the skullcup, toppling in head over heels.  Imagine that no matter how much you take from this nectar, it can never get less, but only increase.  It has become the nectar of life beyond death; the nectar of medicine beyond sickness; and the nectar of wisdom beyond impurity. Blessing the Outer Offerings

record.acip: DE YANG KHYAD CHOS GSUM LDAN ZHES BYA BA, NGO BO'I KHYAD PAR BDE STONG GI RANG BZHIN YIN PA, RNAM PA'I KHYAD PAR MCHOD RDZAS SO SO'I RNAM PAR SHAR BA, BYED LAS KYI KHYAD PAR DBANG PO DRUG GI SPYOD YUL DU ZAG MED KYI BDE BA KHYAD PAR CAN STER BAR BYED PA STE,
record.wylie: de yang khyad chos gsum ldan zhes bya ba, ngo bo'i khyad par bde stong gi rang bzhin yin pa, rnam pa'i khyad par mchod rdzas so so'i rnam par shar ba, byed las kyi khyad par dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can ster bar byed pa ste
record.english: It is said that these offering substances have three features.  The feature of their essence is that their nature is bliss and voidness.  Their feature of their appearance is that they appear in the respective forms of each of the offering substances.  And the feature of their function is that as the objects of the six senses they are able to produce great, immaculate bliss.

record.acip: DE LTA BU'I RIG MA PHUL BA DE DAG RNAL 'BYOR MAR GYUR PA DANG SNYOMS PAR ZHUGS PAS ZAG MED KYI BDE BA THUGS RGYUD LA 'KHRUNGS PAR BSAMS PA GSANG BA SHER DBANG DANG 'BREL BA'I MCHOD PA DANG,
record.wylie: de lta bu'i rig ma phul ba de dag rnal 'byor mar gyur pa dang snyoms par zhugs pas zag med kyi bde ba thugs rgyud la 'khrungs par bsams pa gsang ba sher dbang dang 'brel ba'i mchod pa dang
record.english: Imagine that, when you offer these Enlightened Women, They each turn into the Angel herself, and sit in meditation of union with the Lamas.  This makes immaculate bliss rise up in Their hearts; and thus you have made the secret offering, the one that relates to the empowerment of wisdom.

record.acip: RANG SEMS RDO RJES RNAL 'BYOR MA ZHES PA'I SKABS THUGS KA'I BAm GYI N'A DA LAS RANG 'DRA'I RNAL 'BYOR MA THOD PA THOGS PA DPAG MED SPROS PA RNAMS KYIS BDUD RTZI NAS LUM LUM BCUS TE TSOGS ZHING RNAMS KYI SKU MDUN DU BZUNG BAS LJAGS RDO RJE RTZE GSUM PAR GYUR PA'I DBU RVA LA SBU GU YOD PA NAS 'OD ZER DKAR PO SBUBS CAN 'PHROS PA THOD PA'I NANG GI BDUD RTZIR ZUG NAS GSOL BAS THUGS RGYUD LA ZAG MED KYI BDE BA SKYES, BDE BAS STONG PA NGES PA'I BDE STONG DBYER MED KYI YE SHES THUGS RGYUD LA 'KHRUNGS PAR BSAM ZHING
record.wylie: rang sems rdo rjes rnal 'byor ma zhes pa'i skabs thugs ka'i baM gyi nA da las rang 'dra'i rnal 'byor ma thod pa thogs pa dpag med spros pa rnams kyis bdud rtsi nas lum lum bcus te tshogs zhing rnams kyi sku mdun du bzung bas ljags rdo rje rtse gsum par gyur pa'i dbu rva la sbu gu yod pa nas 'od zer dkar po sbubs can 'phros pa thod pa'i nang gi bdud rtsir zug nas gsol bas thugs rgyud la zag med kyi bde ba skyes, bde bas stong pa nges pa'i bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes thugs rgyud la 'khrungs par bsam zhing
record.english: At the part in the ritual where you say, "My mind becomes the Angel of Diamond..." send forth an inconceivable number of Angels from the crook of the vam at your heart.  Each of the Angels looks like you and bears a cup made of skull.  They scoop up the nectar cup by cup and present it before the holy bodies of the garden of merit. The tongues of the Guests transform into three-spoked diamonds.  From the center spokes come straws of white light; They place the tips of these straws into the nectar in the skulls, and partake of it.  The nectar fills Their minds with pure bliss, and then this bliss brings about in Their holy hearts the wisdom of indivisible bliss and voidness, which sees emptiness directly.

record.acip: LAN BDUN NI KHA SBYOR YAN LAG BDUN LDAN MTSON ZHING DE YANG YAR MGRON RNAMS LA DAD PAS KUN NAS BLANGS TE PHUL BAS ZAG MED KYI BDE BAS MNYES SHING TSIM NAS BDE STONG DBYER MED KYI YE SHES THUGS RGYUD LA GSAR DU 'KHRUNGS PAR BSAM ZHING, MAR MGRON RNAMS KYANG SKAD CIG LA SGRIB GNYIS DAG TSOGS GNYIS RDZOGS TE LUS LONGS SKU RNAL 'BYOR MA DANG, SEMS RTOG MED CHOS SKU THOB NAS RANG RANG GI DAG ZHING DU GSHEGS,
record.wylie: lan bdun ni kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan mtshon zhing de yang yar mgron rnams la dad pas kun nas blangs te phul bas zag med kyi bde bas mnyes shing tshim nas bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes thugs rgyud la gsar du 'khrungs par bsam zhing, mar mgron rnams kyang skad cig la sgrib gnyis dag tshogs gnyis rdzogs te lus longs sku rnal 'byor ma dang, sems rtog med chos sku thob nas rang rang gi dag zhing du gshegs
record.english: In total then you have offered the nectar seven times.  This is to represent the seven qualities of the Union.  [These seven are complete enjoyment, union, great bliss, having no self-nature, being filled with compassion, continuing in an unbroken stream, and being never-ending.] Driven by overwhelming feelings of faith, offer the nectar once more to all the higher Guests.  Imagine that this pleases and fills Them with immaculate bliss, and gives birth in Their hearts the wisdom of indivisible bliss and emptiness. Imagine as well that in a single instant every one of the lower Guests is purified of the two obstacles, and completes the two collections.  Their bodies transform into the enjoyment body of the Angel of Diamond, and Their minds into the Dharma Body free of all wrong conceptions.  Each of Them flies off then to Their own paradise.

record.acip: ZAG BCAS LA MOS PA 'DOD CHAGS DANG ZAG MED LA MOS PA DAD PA YIN, RNAL 'BYOR MA ZER BA RANG LA ZER BA GO BA'I BAR DU NGA RGYAL 'DZIN DGOS,
record.wylie: zag bcas la mos pa 'dod chags dang zag med la mos pa dad pa yin, rnal 'byor ma zer ba rang la zer ba go ba'i bar du nga rgyal 'dzin dgos
record.english: To be attracted to something impure is stupid desire, but to be attracted to something pure is devotion.  You have to keep up this practice of identifying yourself with the Diamond Angel, until the point that if someone called out Her name, you would turn around.

record.acip: DBU SKRA NAG PO SIL BUR 'PHYANG BAS BDAG 'DZIN GYI MDUD PA GROL BAR MTSON, DBU SKRA STANG ZIL DANG BUNG BA LTAR GNAG CES PA'I STANG ZIL NI DNGUL RDO BCAG PA LTAR DANG, BUNG BA NI RGYA NAG NAS THON PA'I RDO GNAG LA SNUM PA ZHIG YIN GSUNGS,
record.wylie: dbu skra nag po sil bur 'phyang bas bdag 'dzin gyi mdud pa grol bar mtshon, dbu skra stang zil dang bung ba ltar gnag ces pa'i stang zil ni dngul rdo bcag pa ltar dang, bung ba ni rgya nag nas thon pa'i rdo gnag la snum pa zhig yin gsungs
record.english: Her holy hair is black, and it hangs down, flowing free.  This represents that She has succeeded in freeing the knots of grasping to a self nature in things.  Our Lama spoke a bit here about the expression "holy hair black as the tangsil, black as bungwa."  He said that tangsil is a mineral that resembles a broken-open piece of what we in Tibet call "silver-stone."  Bungwa, He said, is a kind of rock that comes from China; it is pitch black and has a sheen to it.

record.acip: BUNG BA LTAR GNAG PA NI CHOS DBYINGS STONG PA NYID DU RO GCIG PA MTSON, BUNG BA NI RGYA SOG YUL NAS THON YONG BA'I RDO GNAG CING SNUM PA ZHIG YOD PAR GRAGS SHING, RGYAL BA LNGA PAS STANG ZIL BCAG PA'I DUM BU LTAR GNAG PA ZHES PA DNGUL RDO YIN PAR GSUNG,
record.wylie: bung ba ltar gnag pa ni chos dbyings stong pa nyid du ro gcig pa mtshon, bung ba ni rgya sog yul nas thon yong ba'i rdo gnag cing snum pa zhig yod par grags shing, rgyal ba lnga pas stang zil bcag pa'i dum bu ltar gnag pa zhes pa dngul rdo yin par gsung
record.english: Her hair is "black as the bungwa."  This represents the realm of all things: the fact that all things are one in the realm of emptiness.  It is said that the bungwa is a very black and shiny stone that comes from China or Mongolia.  The Great Fifth Dalai Lama has noted that it has also been described "black as a piece broken from a tangsil stone," which He says refers to the silverstone.

record.acip: SNOD THAMS CAD CHOS 'BYUNG DANG, BCUD KYI SEMS CAN RIGS DRUG THAMS CAD KYI LUS ZAG MED 'JA' LUS DANG, SEMS RTOG MED CHOS SKUR GYUR PAR MOS,
record.wylie: snod thams cad chos 'byung dang, bcud kyi sems can rigs drug thams cad kyi lus zag med 'ja' lus dang, sems rtog med chos skur gyur par mos
record.english: See every world turning to a dharma star; see every living being in every world, beings of all of the six kinds; see their bodies turn to bodies of light, immaculate rainbow bodies, and see their minds turn to the Body of Dharma, free of all conception.

record.acip: SLAR RNAL 'BYOR MAR BSGYUR DGOS GSUNGS, DE NAS NGA RGYAL DANG GSAL SNANG BRTAN POS LUS LA LHA'I 'DU SHES DANG , MKHA' GSANG BYIN GYIS BRLAB PA NGAG LA SNGAGS KYI 'DU SHES, THABS 'DI LTA BU LA BRTEN NAS ZAG MED KYI BDE BA MNGON DU BYA'O SNYAM PA YID LA CHOS KYI 'DU SHES TE 'DU SHES GSUM DANG LDAN PA'I SGO NAS SNYOMS PAR 'JUG TSUL,
record.wylie: slar rnal 'byor mar bsgyur dgos gsungs, de nas nga rgyal dang gsal snang brtan pos lus la lha'i 'du shes dang , mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa ngag la sngags kyi 'du shes, thabs 'di lta bu la brten nas zag med kyi bde ba mngon du bya'o snyam pa yid la chos kyi 'du shes te 'du shes gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas snyoms par 'jug tshul
record.english: At this point, said our Lama, you must turn back into the Holy Lady.  He described then how We must sit together in the meditation of union, maintaining the three different conceptions.  With steady thoughts of supreme confidence and clear vision we conceive of our bodies as Angels.  We conceive of our speech as secret words, due to the blessing of the sky within our secret Angel.  We think to ourselves,  "I shall use this practice as a means to reach immaculate bliss," and conceive of this state of mind as the Dharma. *  *  *  *  * The following selection is from The Secret Treasure of the Angels (ACIP digital text S0202), written by Lama Quicksilver, Ngulchu Dharma Bhadra (1772-1851), folios 86A-90A.

record.acip: GNYIS PA NI, RO RDO RJE MA DMAR MOS THOD PAS NANG MCHOD NAS BCUS TE, RANG RNAL 'BYOR MAR GSAL BA'I MDUN DU BZUNG BA LA LJAGS H'Um LAS SKYES PA'I RDO RJE RTZE GSUM PA'I DBUS RVA'I BUG PA LAS 'OD ZER SBUBS CAN 'PHROS PA NANG MCHOD LA ZUG NAS GSOL BAS ZAG MED KYI BDE BAS TSIM PAR BSAM MO,,
record.wylie: gnyis pa ni, ro rdo rje ma dmar mos thod pas nang mchod nas bcus te, rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i mdun du bzung ba la ljags hUM las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i dbus rva'i bug pa las 'od zer sbubs can 'phros pa nang mchod la zug nas gsol bas zag med kyi bde bas tshim par bsam mo
record.english: As for the second, the inner offering, the crimson Diamond Lady of Tastes scoops up the inner offering in a skullcup. See Her holding it out before You -- who you are picturing as the Diamond Angel.  At your precious tongue comes a letter hung, from which sprouts a three-spoked diamond.  The central spoke turns into a hollow straw of light, which You project forth into the inner offering.  You then partake of this offering, and feel fully satiated with immaculate bliss.

record.acip: SKABS 'GAR 'KHOR LO SDOM PA'I RTEN DANG BRTEN PA YONGS RDZOGS SPROS TE 'OD ZER REG PA TZAM GYIS SNOD KYI 'JIG RTEN THAMS CAD CHOS 'BYUNG NYIS BRTEGS DANG, BCUD KYI SEMS CAN THAMS CAD LUS ZAG MED RNAL 'BYOR MA DANG, SEMS RTOG MED CHOS SKUR GYUR PAR BSAM STE,
record.wylie: skabs 'gar 'khor lo sdom pa'i rten dang brten pa yongs rdzogs spros te 'od zer reg pa tsam gyis snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad chos 'byung nyis brtegs dang, bcud kyi sems can thams cad lus zag med rnal 'byor ma dang, sems rtog med chos skur gyur par bsam ste
record.english: [11] Sometimes you can send out the entire secret world of the Union of Spheres, complete with all of its Angels.  The moment these light rays touch the various places of the world, they are transformed into the two-tiered dharma star.  The instant they reach each of the living beings of the world, they transform their bodies into the immaculate body of the Angel of Diamond, and their minds into the non-conceptual Dharma Body of an Enlightened Being.

record.acip: ZAG MED CES PA DPE'I 'OD GSAL MAN LA YOD PA MA YIN ZHING DON GYI 'OD GSAL DAG PA'I SGYU LUS KHO NA YIN,
record.wylie: zag med ces pa dpe'i 'od gsal man la yod pa ma yin zhing don gyi 'od gsal dag pa'i sgyu lus kho na yin
record.english: When I say "immaculate" I don't mean anything from the approximate clear light on down, but rather that they achieve nothing less than actual clear light and the totally pure illusory body.

record.acip: 'BRAS DUS SU MA DAG PA'I SGYU LUS NAM MKHA' LA SPRIN YAL BA LTAR GYUR NAS, DON GYI 'OD GSAL 'CHAR ZHING, DE DANG MNYAM DU NYON SGRIB SPANGS LA DA DUNG ZUNG 'JUG GI GO 'PHANG MA THOB PAS ZAG MED RLUNG 'OD ZER LNGA PAS NYER LEN BYAS NAS DAG PA'I SGYU LUS RNAL 'BYOR MA'I RNAM PAR LDANG LA,
record.wylie: 'bras dus su ma dag pa'i sgyu lus nam mkha' la sprin yal ba ltar gyur nas, don gyi 'od gsal 'char zhing, de dang mnyam du nyon sgrib spangs la da dung zung 'jug gi go 'phang ma thob pas zag med rlung 'od zer lnga pas nyer len byas nas dag pa'i sgyu lus rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par ldang la
record.english: At the time of the result, that impure illusory body fades away just as a cloud fades away in the sky, and the actual clear light comes to you.  At that same time you eliminate the last of your mental affliction obstacles, but because you have not yet achieved the state of the final union your winds are still impure.  These impure winds appear in the five different colors and then act as the material cause for you to arise in the totally pure illusory body of the Angel of Diamond.

record.acip: AOm, RDO RJE GSUM DBYER MED PA'I BDAG ,RANG NYID BLA MA LHAR GSAL BAS, ,A'A: ZAG MED YE SHES BDUD RTZI CHE, ,H'Um, BYANG CHUB SEMS LAS GA-YO MED PAR, ,LUS GNAS LHA RNAMS TSIM PHYIR ROL, AA HO MA H'A SU KHA,
record.wylie: aoM, rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa'i bdag ,rang nyid bla ma lhar gsal bas, ,a'a: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi che, ,hUM, byang chub sems las ga-yo med par, ,lus gnas lha rnams tshim phyir rol, aa ho ma hA su kha
record.english: Om...--I picture myself as the embodiment of the three diamonds, indivisible.  I myself am the Lama, I am the Angel, and I.... Ah...--take this great and immaculate nectar of wisdom and... Hung...--without wavering from the intent to reach Buddhahood for every living being, I offer it to the Angels living within me; may They revel in it, and partake to Their full. Ah ho mahasukha!

record.acip: LAG MCHOD MI 'GRUB PA'I SKABS KYANG BZA' BTUNG LA LONGS SPYOD TSE GONG GI LAG PA BYIN RLABS DANG, KHA ZAS BDUD RTZIR BYIN BRLABS PA, RNAL 'BYOR MA'I LHA TSOGS RANG LUS LA SPYAN DRANGS TE BZHUGS PA'AM, LUS DKYIL GSAL BTAB PA LA PHUL BAS THUGS ZAG MED KYI BDE BAS TSIM PAR MOS PA SOGS
record.wylie: lag mchod mi 'grub pa'i skabs kyang bza' btung la longs spyod tshe gong gi lag pa byin rlabs dang, kha zas bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa, rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs rang lus la spyan drangs te bzhugs pa'am, lus dkyil gsal btab pa la phul bas thugs zag med kyi bde bas tshim par mos pa sogs
record.english: Even on those occasions when you do not perform the offering of the hand, there are certain steps you should take whenever to partake of food or drink.  As mentioned above, bless your hand, and also bless the food so that it becomes sacred nectar.  Invite the entire Angelic assembly of the Holy Angel to come down and be in you, or else visualize the Angels of the secret world of your body, and offer the nectar to these Beings.  Believe then that Their holy minds have been filled with immaculate bliss.

record.english: This actual practice occurs at the end of the secret world offering, at that point where we say, "those objects which inspire in me attachment, anger and ignorance..."27  Objects which inspire attachment are those which appear attractive.  Objects which lead us to anger are those which seem unpleasant.  And those objects which fall somewhere in between these two are those objects which invoke the perpetuation of our ignorance.  So in addition to our secret world offering, it is a powerful practice to pray for the death of our attachment and anger, by offering these objects without hesitation. _______________

record.english: And this is how it works for the goals of others.  We believe that through our holy deeds--by being touched and so on by the rays of light--every living creature is purified of their negativities and obstacles.  And due to this, their bodies are transformed into an angel's immaculate body of enjoyment, and their minds are transformed into the dharma body, devoid of conceptual thought.

record.english: Now "immaculate" means the actual clear light, from which one rises up into the pure body of illusion.

record.english: Then this very illusory body becomes like a cloud dissolving in the sky, and the actual clear light arises.  And together with this we purify ourselves of negative thoughts and obstacles; but we haven't yet achieved the actual union of the two.  And so, with the five light rays from our now immaculate winds acting as the material cause, we rise up into the pure illusory body.

record.english: One reaches a point where, because you have trained yourself well in using inner fire to induce the life wind to enter the channel of the dance, the winds go through the three steps of entering, staying, and dissolving.  And the power of this gives you the ability to lock in the element of enlightenment: to prevent it from dripping out. You take this ability and then go on to practice with an actual consort, which acts as a contributing cause for the development of the four forms of bliss.  It was because he was trying to learn to bring on these four kinds of bliss that Marpa, as He says, "received, most especially, the inner fire and actual consort."

record.english: We also find descriptions where, in order to clarify certain points on the stage of creation, one sets up a special room. Inside this room you set up a whole variety of objects, including paintings of holy beings and the like, which you get to reflect in mirrors. And then you teach the student to stare at the mirror and meditate that way. This is all some kind of mixed-up version of teachings that can be found in the systems of Lord Marpa and Gu.

record.english: At this point, said our Lama, you must turn back into the Holy Lady.  He described then how We must sit together in the meditation of union, maintaining the three different conceptions, as follows.  With steady thoughts of supreme confidence and clear vision we conceive of our body as an Angels.  We conceive of our speech as secret words, due to the blessing of the sky.  We think to ourselves, "I shall use this practice as a means to reach immaculate bliss," and conceive of this state of mind as the Dharma. * Various Kinds of Mudras Aside from the very broad division of spiritual partners into the actual and the imagined, there are a great number other classifications of partners outlined in scripture. When we have stopped these visions from appearing to our perceptions, then we take emptiness as the object as we take it to be.  And then we remain in single-pointed meditation upon it.

record.english: Suppose as well that we fail to have a conception of our own mind as being the Dharma itself--where we hope to dispel other's lack of faith, and where we maintain a motivation that, through engaging in these particular means, we will be able to bring on immaculate bliss.  Or suppose further that we engage in practice with a Woman of Knowledge in any other way which is prohibited in the secret teachings--practicing with Her, for example, at the wrong time.  We will then incur this serious offense. * * * An important set of tantric vows common to most tantric systems consists of those of the Five Enlightened Families.  As we see from Geshe Tsewang Samdrup (S00201, f. 27a), one of these stipulates that we practice with a spiritual partner.

record.english: By force of these events, the central channel opens, and all the winds and mind dissolve into this channel, turning into a single song.  The body becomes totally pure; the mind goes beyond all concepts of self-existence; and you achieve the marriage of an enlightened physical form and an enlightened state of wisdom.  According to this particular system, you can achieve the goal without necessarily engaging in deep practice with a consort. This concludes the section on the practice for those who are attracted to the path of deep practice.

record.english: If you want greater bliss, then imagine that it is being turned to the left.  If the turning is too strong, there's a risk that it will spill out.  If you do this meditation until it's strong, then later on it will be a breeze when you practice the path of the Messenger.  This practice itself though is not the actual path of the Messenger; rather, it is only a related instruction.

record.english: Here finally is the third overall step: the crucial point of the ultimate goal, or nirvana.  This is the union of the two: the immaculate body, or physical body of an enlightened being; and the state of mind free of all ideas of self-existence, or the truth body of an enlightened being.

record.english: Then comes the Diamond Lady of Tastes, carrying a vessel filled with various things to taste, each with the ability to inspire immaculate bliss in the sense organ of the tongue.  Next is the Diamond Lady of Touches, who holds forth various types of things to touch, in the form of different kinds of clothing with their own power to bring extraordinary bliss to the sense power of the body.  The expression "the very best" in the lines here is meant to be applied to all five of these objects of the senses, and conveys an idea of excellence.
